_comment: Project-level MCP servers. Checked into the repo so every contributor gets the same servers; per-user secrets live in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored). Token format: classic PAT or fine-grained PAT with repo + workflow scopes. To rotate: `gh auth refresh -s repo,workflow` then re-export. First run pulls ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server (~30 MB).
